name: Surreal Porcelain Couture
image_vibe: white tactile symbiosis, quiet atelier minimalism

prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic close-up portrait in a sunlit plaster atelier with a translucent vellum fractal collar and headpiece.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman with poised ethereal gaze, sleek pulled-back hair, natural pores and peach fuzz, wearing a structural bone-white collar and matching headpiece of thin translucent vellum layers forming coral-like fractals around the shoulders and neck; chin lifted in a slight side turn.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 close-up at eye level, rule-of-thirds portrait, matte plaster and clay atelier, slate-grey creamy bokeh, shoulders and neck framed by the collar.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft directional Rembrandt side light through heavy linen curtains, gentle sophisticated shadows, high-key monochrome tactile atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Hasselblad H6D-100c, 80mm f/1.9, 5600K, medium-format detail, sharp eyes and vellum edges, realistic skin texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic 4:5 close-up editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with sleek pulled-back hair and poised ethereal gaze, wearing a structural bone-white collar and matching translucent vellum fractal headpiece blooming around shoulders and neck, slight side turn with chin lifted, sunlit plaster atelier, slate-grey bokeh, soft Rembrandt window light through linen curtains, Hasselblad H6D-100c 80mm f/1.9, 5600K, tactile skin and paper grain, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sharp material touching skin, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, digital haze, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: porcelain vellum couture reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the white fractal collar, pulled-back hair, close-up, plaster atelier, and side light; keep adult fictional identity and material construction replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the tactile symbiosis concept and safe wearable structure; use a clearly adult fictional identity.

changes: Clarified adult fictional subject and safe wearable vellum structure; removed named designer aesthetic.
policy_review.notes: Couture close-up is non-graphic and nonsexual.
